The '''Fire Mountain Rally''' was one of several [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] events that were hosted by the Pro Circuit during the last years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. The race meandered around the mountainous coastal areas of the [[Baroo/Legends|Baroo]] continent on the planet [[Baroonda/Legends|Baroonda]]. This course was the sixth race in the [[Galactic Podracing Circuit/Legends|Galactic Podracing Circuit]] Tournament. [[Ebe E. Endocott/Legends|Ebe Endocott]] favored this course. During [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphid]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]] was captured by a [[Unidentified mercenary (Baroonda)|mercenary]], on behalf of the [[Fluggrian/Legends|Fluggrian]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Kam Nale]], during the race.
